description: End a session and discard its workbook: the session_id stops working and the session can't be reopened. Edits not saved with save_to_library (or downloaded with export_workbook) are lost, and its commit_session checkpoints go with it, so restore_session can't bring it back. Call it when you're done with a workbook, or to free a slot when create_session fails with max_sessions. Returns {closed: true}, plus unsaved: true and a hint when the workbook was edited since it was opened or last saved to the Library. An unknown, expired or already closed session_id fails with session_not_found, which lists the sessions still open. Sessions also close on their own after 30 minutes without a call.

session_id.description: ID of the session to close, from create_session or list_sessions

name: close_session
title: Close session
